statement: You are given an array prices, where prices[i] is the price of a stock on day i. You are also given a fee.
You may make as many trades as you like, holding at most one share at a time. Every completed trade (a buy and its sell) costs fee once.
Return the largest total profit you can make after fees.

examples.explanation: Buy at 1 and sell at 8 (7 − 2 = 5), then buy at 4 and sell at 9 (5 − 2 = 3), for 8 in total.
One trade from 1 to 10 earns 9 − 3 = 6. Splitting it into 1 → 7 and 5 → 10 pays the fee twice and earns only 3 + 2 = 5.
